items.title: Infleqtion (INFQ) Lands Quantum Grid Reliability Subcontract
items.summary: Infleqtion (NYSE:INFQ) has entered a new subcontract with Eaton to apply quantum computing to power grid reliability and contingency analysis. The project focuses on using Infleqtion's quantum algorithms to help utilities assess complex grid scenarios that are difficult to handle with classical computing. items.title: What Does Eaton (ETN) Winning An Air Force Quantum Grid Contract Mean?
items.summary: Eaton (NYSE:ETN) received a U.S. Air Force Research Laboratory contract to apply quantum computing and machine learning for power grid resilience. The project focuses on advanced security solutions for critical infrastructure, extending beyond Eaton's existing electrification and data center work.
